# Scope or contract change record

Date/author; user authorization or technical evidence; prior decision/requirement; new choice and reason; RELEASE/FUTURE/external-gap effect; affected source mapping, requirements, tasks/dependencies, tests, screens, APIs/schema, data/model/audio and security/deployment; migration/retest plan; exact changed files; unresolved risks. Preserve old evidence and link supersession. An assistant's convenience or deadline pressure is not owner approval to remove a must-have.
